giai_thich: The cochlea mainly consists of the cochlea and hair cells, where sound waves are transformed into electrical signals sent to the brain. The hair cells in the cochlea detect different sound frequencies, allowing humans to distinguish sounds. Interestingly, if the hair cells are damaged, hearing ability will be severely affected.
